title: The Widower's Nest Gopher
description: The Widower's Nest Gopher — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Deliver

Quest Description: Deliver Soldier Clohz a care package on level 1 of Widower's Nest

Quest Reward: 4375 Gold

Return to: Soldier Clohz

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill the P.M.T.A.C.C.C. Leader in the dungeon off of Level 7 of the Widower's Nest and Report to Gwen of the Tree Folk in Townston.

Offer:

Since you are here, Dungeon Runner, can you take care of something for me? There is a Monster in the dungeon off of Level 7 of the Widower's Nest and last week Gwen of the Tree Folk was doing her weekly nature hike and came across a Poison Mutant that was killing small woodland creatures trying to farm gold to fund its new fragrance line. It was obviously a high ranking member of Poison Mutants for the Torture and Antagonizing of Cute Cuddly Creatures.

She asked me to kill the monster, but that thing is huge and scares me to death. Can you go and take care of it for me? Then go back to Townston and tell Gwen that I took care of it? I know, its lame, but I am a total scaredy Dungeon Runner, and I really like Gwen so you would be doing me a huge favor! Will you do it?

Turn-in:

Hi, Dungeon Runner. What can I do for you? Oh, he killed that terrible monster? Oh, thank goodness. Now those cute cuddly critters are in no danger of running around the Widower's Nest smelling like elderberries and socks.

I've seen how you have been running around with your head cutoff helping everyone, so here is a nice reward for you.

Objectives:

  • Kill the P.M.T.A.C.C.C. Leader

Level range: 35–40
